name: Send to On-Screen Notes
description: Right-click a picture, GIF or video, or pick one, to put it on your On-Screen Notes slide.

action.default_title: Pick a picture, GIF or video to send to On-Screen Notes

post.description: Send all pictures of the post under the pointer

frame.description: Send the frame of the video under the pointer

record.description: Record the video under the pointer as it plays

artist.description: Find the artist of the picture under the pointer, then send

look.description: Look for the picture under the pointer in my slides

tag-artist.description: Tag as the artist (Find artist): the highlighted name, or the link under the pointer

same-artist.description: Same as the last artist (Find artist)
